page.title: Your weekly
page.lead: Every Sunday at 6 AM — the coming week's tithi, nakshatra, fasts, festivals and auspicious timings, in simple Hindi, straight to your inbox.
page.confirmedBody: Welcome aboard. Your first issue arrives this coming Sunday.
page.invalidBody: It may have expired or already been used. Subscribe again below and we'll send a fresh link.
page.panchangBody: Each day's tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana and sunrise–sunset at a glance.
page.festivalsBody: Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya and major festivals — with the right dates and puja timings.
page.muhurtaBody: The week's good timings for griha pravesh, buying a vehicle or starting something new — plus Rahu Kaal.
